title: Geller boards a landed UFO in the Sinai Desert and returns with a pen

tellings.quote: this UFO lands, Geller goes into like a trance, boards the the UFO,

plain: Around 1971 or 1972, a UFO is said to have landed in the Sinai Desert, and the self-described psychic Uri Geller went into a kind of trance, boarded it, and came back with a pen. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells Michels this, summarising a book about Geller by Andrija Puharich, a researcher who worked closely with him. If true, Geller's powers would be linked to direct contact with the craft.
